meta.title: Concept directions at one layer: 3D display projection and exact cosines
meta.model_config: mean-difference directions in the residual stream at language_29_D5120, all drawn from a common origin

units.display_endpoint: coordinates of the unit-normalised direction in the shared 3D display basis; its length (display_norm, 0-1) is the share of the direction that the display retains
units.raw_norm: norm of the analysis input before the figure's unit normalisation (see raw_norm_definition); not an activation-scale magnitude
units.full_space_unit_norm: norm of the direction as used for the projection and the cosines (1 by construction)
units.cosine_matrix.values: signed cosine similarity in the full activation space, -1 to 1; rows and columns follow cosine_matrix.ids

meta.aggregation: directions are the saved mean-difference vectors; gender and country are averages over per-emotion / per-persona directions, as in control/III1_vector_control/control.py; projection and cosines are computed by this script and reproduce results/EX1_T1_workload_analytics.ipynb
caveats: This is a 3D display projection of 5120-dimensional directions. Angles and lengths in the display are approximate; exact alignment is given by cosine_matrix.
Geometric alignment between directions does not establish an intervention effect: no causal claim follows from this figure.
Directions with a small display_norm lie mostly outside the displayed subspace and their displayed angles are the least reliable.

The saved mean-difference directions are unit-normalised; their original activation-scale magnitudes were not saved, so raw_norm is 1 for single contrasts and below 1 for averaged directions (it then measures how well the averaged directions agree).
Directions are estimated from different contrasts and sample sizes on a single model, prompt template and image sample.

projection.method: top-3 uncentered SVD of the unit-normalised directions listed under 'directions' (one basis for all of them)
projection.centering: none: the direction set is not mean-centred, so the zero vector maps to the display origin
projection.sign_convention: each component is oriented so that the direction with the largest absolute coordinate on it has a positive coordinate
projection.components: not published (three 5120-dimensional vectors); identified by projection_hash
projection.explained_variance_definition: share of the total squared norm of the unit directions captured by each component (uncentered)

directions.label: Workload / stress: overwhelming − minimal
directions.raw_norm_definition: norm of the saved mean-difference direction (saved unit-normalised)
directions.condition_definition: blank prompt plus the single attribute 'Mental workload: overwhelming' minus the same prompt with 'Mental workload: minimal'

directions.label: Excitement − anger
directions.raw_norm_definition: norm of the saved mean-difference direction (saved unit-normalised)
directions.condition_definition: gender-averaged excitement personas minus gender-averaged anger personas, base persona set; the direction targeted by the excited-vs-angry UAP

directions.label: Gender: female − male (averaged over emotions)
directions.raw_norm_definition: norm of the mean of 8 saved unit-normalised mean-difference directions, before re-normalisation
directions.condition_definition: mean of the eight emotion-matched female-minus-male directions, base persona set

directions.label: Country: Germany
directions.raw_norm_definition: norm of the mean of 16 saved unit-normalised mean-difference directions, before re-normalisation
directions.condition_definition: mean over the 16 gender x emotion personas of (persona extended with Country = Germany) minus (same persona without a country)

directions.label: Country: Nigeria
directions.raw_norm_definition: norm of the mean of 16 saved unit-normalised mean-difference directions, before re-normalisation
directions.condition_definition: mean over the 16 gender x emotion personas of (persona extended with Country = Nigeria) minus (same persona without a country)
